server.name: io.github.vcode-sh/dokploy-mcp
server.description: Dokploy MCP server for Codex, Cursor, and Claude with compact stdio and hosted HTTP modes
server.title: Dokploy MCP

environmentVariables.description: Optional when local Dokploy credentials already exist. Otherwise provide the Dokploy panel URL.
environmentVariables.name: DOKPLOY_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional when local Dokploy credentials already exist. Otherwise provide the Dokploy API key.
environmentVariables.name: DOKPLOY_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional JSON object of named Dokploy targets. Use this when you want explicit named profiles in addition to the local default target.
environmentVariables.name: DOKPLOY_PROFILES_JSON

headers.description: Dokploy panel URL for this request. Accepts the panel URL, /api, or /api/trpc and is normalized automatically.
headers.name: X-Dokploy-Url

headers.description: Dokploy API key from Settings > Profile > API/CLI.
headers.name: X-Dokploy-Api-Key

mcpPath.description: MCP HTTP path exposed by the hosted server.

remoteHost.description: Hostname of your hosted dokploy-mcp server without the https:// prefix.
